546	    def _generate_planning_step(
547	        self, task, is_first_step: bool, step: int
548	    ) -> Generator[ChatMessageStreamDelta | PlanningStep]:
549	        start_time = time.time()
550	        if is_first_step:
551	            input_messages = [
552	                {
553	                    "role": MessageRole.USER,
554	                    "content": [
555	                        {
556	                            "type": "text",
557	                            "text": populate_template(
558	                                self.prompt_templates["planning"]["initial_plan"],
559	                                variables={"task": task, "tools": self.tools, "managed_agents": self.managed_agents},
560	                            ),
561	                        }
562	                    ],
563	                }
564	            ]
565	            if self.stream_outputs and hasattr(self.model, "generate_stream"):
566	                plan_message_content = ""
567	                output_stream = self.model.generate_stream(input_messages, stop_sequences=["<end_plan>"])  # type: ignore
568	                input_tokens, output_tokens = 0, 0
569	                with Live("", console=self.logger.console, vertical_overflow="visible") as live:
570	                    for event in output_stream:
571	                        if event.content is not None:
572	                            plan_message_content += event.content
573	                            live.update(Markdown(plan_message_content))
574	                            if event.token_usage:
575	                                output_tokens += event.token_usage.output_tokens
576	                                input_tokens = event.token_usage.input_tokens
577	                        yield event
578	            else:
579	                plan_message = self.model.generate(input_messages, stop_sequences=["<end_plan>"])
580	                plan_message_content = plan_message.content
581	                input_tokens, output_tokens = (
582	                    plan_message.token_usage.input_tokens,
583	                    plan_message.token_usage.output_tokens,
584	                )
585	            plan = textwrap.dedent(
586	                f"""Here are the facts I know and the plan of action that I will follow to solve the task:\n```\n{plan_message_content}\n```"""
587	            )
588	        else:
589	            # Summary mode removes the system prompt and previous planning messages output by the model.
590	            # Removing previous planning messages avoids influencing too much the new plan.
591	            memory_messages = self.write_memory_to_messages(summary_mode=True)
592	            plan_update_pre = {
593	                "role": MessageRole.SYSTEM,
594	                "content": [
595	                    {
596	                        "type": "text",
597	                        "text": populate_template(
598	                            self.prompt_templates["planning"]["update_plan_pre_messages"], variables={"task": task}
599	                        ),
600	                    }
601	                ],
602	            }
603	            plan_update_post = {
604	                "role": MessageRole.USER,
605	                "content": [
606	                    {
607	                        "type": "text",
608	                        "text": populate_template(
609	                            self.prompt_templates["planning"]["update_plan_post_messages"],
610	                            variables={
611	                                "task": task,
612	                                "tools": self.tools,
613	                                "managed_agents": self.managed_agents,
614	                                "remaining_steps": (self.max_steps - step),
615	                            },
616	                        ),
617	                    }
618	                ],
619	            }
620	            input_messages = [plan_update_pre] + memory_messages + [plan_update_post]
621	            if self.stream_outputs and hasattr(self.model, "generate_stream"):
622	                plan_message_content = ""
623	                input_tokens, output_tokens = 0, 0
624	                with Live("", console=self.logger.console, vertical_overflow="visible") as live:
625	                    for event in self.model.generate_stream(
626	                        input_messages,
627	                        stop_sequences=["<end_plan>"],
628	                    ):  # type: ignore
629	                        if event.content is not None:
630	                            plan_message_content += event.content
631	                            live.update(Markdown(plan_message_content))
632	                            if event.token_usage:
633	                                output_tokens += event.token_usage.output_tokens
634	                                input_tokens = event.token_usage.input_tokens
635	                        yield event
636	            else:
637	                plan_message = self.model.generate(input_messages, stop_sequences=["<end_plan>"])
638	                plan_message_content = plan_message.content
639	                input_tokens, output_tokens = (
640	                    plan_message.token_usage.input_tokens,
641	                    plan_message.token_usage.output_tokens,
642	                )
643	            plan = textwrap.dedent(
644	                f"""I still need to solve the task I was given:\n```\n{self.task}\n```\n\nHere are the facts I know and my new/updated plan of action to solve the task:\n```\n{plan_message_content}\n```"""
645	            )
646	        log_headline = "Initial plan" if is_first_step else "Updated plan"
647	        self.logger.log(Rule(f"[bold]{log_headline}", style="orange"), Text(plan), level=LogLevel.INFO)
648	        yield PlanningStep(
649	            model_input_messages=input_messages,
650	            plan=plan,
651	            model_output_message=ChatMessage(role=MessageRole.ASSISTANT, content=plan_message_content),
652	            token_usage=TokenUsage(input_tokens=input_tokens, output_tokens=output_tokens),
653	            timing=Timing(start_time=start_time, end_time=time.time()),
654	        )

701	    def extract_action(self, model_output: str, split_token: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
702	        """
703	        Parse action from the LLM output
704	
705	        Args:
706	            model_output (`str`): Output of the LLM
707	            split_token (`str`): Separator for the action. Should match the example in the system prompt.
708	        """
709	        try:
710	            split = model_output.split(split_token)
711	            rationale, action = (
712	                split[-2],
713	                split[-1],
714	            )  # NOTE: using indexes starting from the end solves for when you have more than one split_token in the output
715	        except Exception:
716	            raise AgentParsingError(
717	                f"No '{split_token}' token provided in your output.\nYour output:\n{model_output}\n. Be sure to include an action, prefaced with '{split_token}'!",
718	                self.logger,
719	            )
720	        return rationale.strip(), action.strip()

930	            if getattr(self, attr, None):

963	    @classmethod
964	    def from_dict(cls, agent_dict: dict[str, Any], **kwargs) -> "MultiStepAgent":
965	        """Create agent from a dictionary representation.
966	
967	        Args:
968	            agent_dict (`dict[str, Any]`): Dictionary representation of the agent.
969	            **kwargs: Additional keyword arguments that will override agent_dict values.
970	
971	        Returns:
972	            `MultiStepAgent`: Instance of the agent class.
973	        """
974	        # Load model
975	        model_info = agent_dict["model"]
976	        model_class = getattr(importlib.import_module("smolagents.models"), model_info["class"])
977	        model = model_class.from_dict(model_info["data"])
978	        # Load tools
979	        tools = []
980	        for tool_info in agent_dict["tools"]:
981	            tools.append(Tool.from_code(tool_info["code"]))
982	        # Load managed agents
983	        managed_agents = []
984	        for managed_agent_name, managed_agent_class_name in agent_dict["managed_agents"].items():
985	            managed_agent_class = getattr(importlib.import_module("smolagents.agents"), managed_agent_class_name)
986	            managed_agents.append(managed_agent_class.from_dict(agent_dict["managed_agents"][managed_agent_name]))
987	        # Extract base agent parameters
988	        agent_args = {
989	            "model": model,
990	            "tools": tools,
991	            "prompt_templates": agent_dict.get("prompt_templates"),
992	            "max_steps": agent_dict.get("max_steps"),
993	            "verbosity_level": agent_dict.get("verbosity_level"),
994	            "grammar": agent_dict.get("grammar"),
995	            "planning_interval": agent_dict.get("planning_interval"),
996	            "name": agent_dict.get("name"),
997	            "description": agent_dict.get("description"),
998	        }
999	        # Filter out None values to use defaults from __init__
1000	        agent_args = {k: v for k, v in agent_args.items() if v is not None}
1001	        # Update with any additional kwargs
1002	        agent_args.update(kwargs)
1003	        # Create agent instance
1004	        return cls(**agent_args)

1017	        <Tip warning={true}>
1018	
1019	        Loading a tool from the Hub means that you'll download the tool and execute it locally.
1020	        ALWAYS inspect the tool you're downloading before loading it within your runtime, as you would do when

1279	    def process_tool_calls(self, chat_message: ChatMessage, memory_step: ActionStep):
1280	        """Process tool calls from the model output and update agent memory.
1281	
1282	        Args:
1283	            chat_message (`ChatMessage`): Chat message containing tool calls from the model.
1284	            memory_step (`ActionStep)`: Memory ActionStep to update with results.
1285	
1286	        Yields:
1287	            `FinalOutput`: The final output of tool execution.
1288	        """
1289	        model_outputs = []
1290	        tool_calls = []
1291	        observations = []
1292	
1293	        final_answer_call = None
1294	        parallel_calls = []
1295	        for tool_call in chat_message.tool_calls:
1296	            tool_name = tool_call.function.name
1297	            tool_arguments = tool_call.function.arguments
1298	            model_outputs.append(str(f"Called Tool: '{tool_name}' with arguments: {tool_arguments}"))
1299	            tool_calls.append(ToolCall(name=tool_name, arguments=tool_arguments, id=tool_call.id))
1300	            # Track final_answer separately, add others to parallel processing list
1301	            if tool_name == "final_answer":
1302	                final_answer_call = (tool_name, tool_arguments)
1303	                break  # Stop: final answer reached, no further tool calls
1304	            else:
1305	                parallel_calls.append((tool_name, tool_arguments))
1306	
1307	        # Helper function to process a single tool call
1308	        def process_single_tool_call(call_info):
1309	            tool_name, tool_arguments = call_info
1310	            self.logger.log(
1311	                Panel(Text(f"Calling tool: '{tool_name}' with arguments: {tool_arguments}")),
1312	                level=LogLevel.INFO,
1313	            )
1314	            if tool_arguments is None:
1315	                tool_arguments = {}
1316	            tool_call_result = self.execute_tool_call(tool_name, tool_arguments)
1317	            tool_call_result_type = type(tool_call_result)
1318	            if tool_call_result_type in [AgentImage, AgentAudio]:
1319	                if tool_call_result_type == AgentImage:
1320	                    observation_name = "image.png"
1321	                elif tool_call_result_type == AgentAudio:
1322	                    observation_name = "audio.mp3"
1323	                # TODO: tool_call_result naming could allow for different names of same type

1333

1341	                # If multiple tool calls, process them in parallel
1342	                with ThreadPoolExecutor(self.max_tool_threads) as executor:
1343	                    futures = [executor.submit(process_single_tool_call, call_info) for call_info in parallel_calls]
1344	                    for future in as_completed(futures):

1347	
1348	        # Process final_answer call if present
1349	        if final_answer_call:
1350	            tool_name, tool_arguments = final_answer_call
1351	            self.logger.log(
1352	                Panel(Text(f"Calling tool: '{tool_name}' with arguments: {tool_arguments}")),
1353	                level=LogLevel.INFO,
1354	            )
1355	            answer = (
1356	                tool_arguments["answer"]
1357	                if isinstance(tool_arguments, dict) and "answer" in tool_arguments
1358	                else tool_arguments
1359	            )
1360	            if isinstance(answer, str) and answer in self.state.keys():
1361	                # if the answer is a state variable, return the value

1363	                final_answer = self.state[answer]
1364	                self.logger.log(
1365	                    f"[bold {YELLOW_HEX}]Final answer:[/bold {YELLOW_HEX}] Extracting key '{answer}' from state to return value '{final_answer}'.",
1366	                    level=LogLevel.INFO,
1367	                )
1368	            else:

1373	                    level=LogLevel.INFO,
1374	                )
1375	            memory_step.action_output = final_answer
1376	            yield FinalOutput(output=final_answer)
1377	
1378	        # Update memory step with all results
1379	        if model_outputs:
1380	            memory_step.model_output = "\n".join(model_outputs)
1381	        if tool_calls:
1382	            memory_step.tool_calls = tool_calls
1383	        if observations:
1384	            memory_step.observations = "\n".join(observations)

1395	    def execute_tool_call(self, tool_name: str, arguments: dict[str, str] | str) -> Any:

1407	        if tool_name not in available_tools:
1408	            raise AgentToolExecutionError(
1409	                f"Unknown tool {tool_name}, should be one of: {', '.join(available_tools)}.", self.logger
1410	            )
1411	
1412	        # Get the tool and substitute state variables in arguments
1413	        tool = available_tools[tool_name]
1414	        arguments = self._substitute_state_variables(arguments)
1415	        is_managed_agent = tool_name in self.managed_agents
1416

1418	            # Call tool with appropriate arguments
1419	            if isinstance(arguments, dict):
1420	                return tool(**arguments) if is_managed_agent else tool(**arguments, sanitize_inputs_outputs=True)
1421	            elif isinstance(arguments, str):

1423	            else:
1424	                raise TypeError(f"Unsupported arguments type: {type(arguments)}")
1425	
1426	        except TypeError as e:
1427	            # Handle invalid arguments
1428	            description = getattr(tool, "description", "No description")
1429	            if is_managed_agent:
1430	                error_msg = (
1431	                    f"Invalid request to team member '{tool_name}' with arguments {json.dumps(arguments)}: {e}\n"
1432	                    "You should call this team member with a valid request.\n"
1433	                    f"Team member description: {description}"
1434	                )
1435	            else:
1436	                error_msg = (
1437	                    f"Invalid call to tool '{tool_name}' with arguments {json.dumps(arguments)}: {e}\n"
1438	                    "You should call this tool with correct input arguments.\n"
1439	                    f"Expected inputs: {json.dumps(tool.inputs)}\n"
1440	                    f"Returns output type: {tool.output_type}\n"
1441	                    f"Tool description: '{description}'"
1442	                )
1443	            raise AgentToolCallError(error_msg, self.logger) from e
1444	
1445	        except Exception as e:
1446	            # Handle execution errors
1447	            if is_managed_agent:
1448	                error_msg = (
1449	                    f"Error executing request to team member '{tool_name}' with arguments {json.dumps(arguments)}: {e}\n"
1450	                    "Please try again or request to another team member"
1451	                )
1452	            else:
1453	                error_msg = (
1454	                    f"Error executing tool '{tool_name}' with arguments {json.dumps(arguments)}: {type(e).__name__}: {e}\n"

199	def get_clean_message_list(
200	    message_list: list[dict[str, str | list[dict]]],
201	    role_conversions: dict[MessageRole, MessageRole] | dict[str, str] = {},
202	    convert_images_to_image_urls: bool = False,
203	    flatten_messages_as_text: bool = False,
204	) -> list[dict[str, str | list[dict]]]:
205	    """
206	    Subsequent messages with the same role will be concatenated to a single message.
207	    output_message_list is a list of messages that will be used to generate the final message that is chat template compatible with transformers LLM chat template.
208	
209	    Args:
210	        message_list (`list[dict[str, str]]`): List of chat messages.
211	        role_conversions (`dict[MessageRole, MessageRole]`, *optional* ): Mapping to convert roles.
212	        convert_images_to_image_urls (`bool`, default `False`): Whether to convert images to image URLs.
213	        flatten_messages_as_text (`bool`, default `False`): Whether to flatten messages as text.
214	    """
215	    output_message_list: list[dict[str, str | list[dict]]] = []
216	    message_list = deepcopy(message_list)  # Avoid modifying the original list
217	    for message in message_list:
218	        role = message["role"]
219	        if role not in MessageRole.roles():
220	            raise ValueError(f"Incorrect role {role}, only {MessageRole.roles()} are supported for now.")
221	
222	        if role in role_conversions:
223	            message["role"] = role_conversions[role]  # type: ignore
224	        # encode images if needed
225	        if isinstance(message["content"], list):
226	            for element in message["content"]:
227	                assert isinstance(element, dict), "Error: this element should be a dict:" + str(element)
228	                if element["type"] == "image":
229	                    assert not flatten_messages_as_text, f"Cannot use images with {flatten_messages_as_text=}"
230	                    if convert_images_to_image_urls:
231	                        element.update(
232	                            {
233	                                "type": "image_url",
234	                                "image_url": {"url": make_image_url(encode_image_base64(element.pop("image")))},
235	                            }
236	                        )
237	                    else:
238	                        element["image"] = encode_image_base64(element["image"])
239	
240	        if len(output_message_list) > 0 and message["role"] == output_message_list[-1]["role"]:
241	            assert isinstance(message["content"], list), "Error: wrong content:" + str(message["content"])
242	            if flatten_messages_as_text:
243	                output_message_list[-1]["content"] += "\n" + message["content"][0]["text"]
244	            else:
245	                for el in message["content"]:
246	                    if el["type"] == "text" and output_message_list[-1]["content"][-1]["type"] == "text":
247	                        # Merge consecutive text messages rather than creating new ones
248	                        output_message_list[-1]["content"][-1]["text"] += "\n" + el["text"]
249	                    else:
250	                        output_message_list[-1]["content"].append(el)
251	        else:
252	            if flatten_messages_as_text:
253	                content = message["content"][0]["text"]
254	            else:
255	                content = message["content"]
256	            output_message_list.append({"role": message["role"], "content": content})
257	    return output_message_list

199	def get_clean_message_list(
200	    message_list: list[dict[str, str | list[dict]]],
201	    role_conversions: dict[MessageRole, MessageRole] | dict[str, str] = {},
202	    convert_images_to_image_urls: bool = False,
203	    flatten_messages_as_text: bool = False,
204	) -> list[dict[str, str | list[dict]]]:
205	    """
206	    Subsequent messages with the same role will be concatenated to a single message.
207	    output_message_list is a list of messages that will be used to generate the final message that is chat template compatible with transformers LLM chat template.
208	
209	    Args:
210	        message_list (`list[dict[str, str]]`): List of chat messages.
211	        role_conversions (`dict[MessageRole, MessageRole]`, *optional* ): Mapping to convert roles.
212	        convert_images_to_image_urls (`bool`, default `False`): Whether to convert images to image URLs.
213	        flatten_messages_as_text (`bool`, default `False`): Whether to flatten messages as text.
214	    """
215	    output_message_list: list[dict[str, str | list[dict]]] = []
216	    message_list = deepcopy(message_list)  # Avoid modifying the original list
217	    for message in message_list:
218	        role = message["role"]
219	        if role not in MessageRole.roles():
220	            raise ValueError(f"Incorrect role {role}, only {MessageRole.roles()} are supported for now.")
221	
222	        if role in role_conversions:
223	            message["role"] = role_conversions[role]  # type: ignore
224	        # encode images if needed
225	        if isinstance(message["content"], list):
226	            for element in message["content"]:
227	                assert isinstance(element, dict), "Error: this element should be a dict:" + str(element)
228	                if element["type"] == "image":
229	                    assert not flatten_messages_as_text, f"Cannot use images with {flatten_messages_as_text=}"
230	                    if convert_images_to_image_urls:
231	                        element.update(
232	                            {
233	                                "type": "image_url",
234	                                "image_url": {"url": make_image_url(encode_image_base64(element.pop("image")))},
235	                            }
236	                        )
237	                    else:
238	                        element["image"] = encode_image_base64(element["image"])
239	
240	        if len(output_message_list) > 0 and message["role"] == output_message_list[-1]["role"]:
241	            assert isinstance(message["content"], list), "Error: wrong content:" + str(message["content"])
242	            if flatten_messages_as_text:
243	                output_message_list[-1]["content"] += "\n" + message["content"][0]["text"]
244	            else:
245	                for el in message["content"]:
246	                    if el["type"] == "text" and output_message_list[-1]["content"][-1]["type"] == "text":
247	                        # Merge consecutive text messages rather than creating new ones
248	                        output_message_list[-1]["content"][-1]["text"] += "\n" + el["text"]
249	                    else:
250	                        output_message_list[-1]["content"].append(el)
251	        else:
252	            if flatten_messages_as_text:
253	                content = message["content"][0]["text"]
254	            else:
255	                content = message["content"]
256	            output_message_list.append({"role": message["role"], "content": content})
257	    return output_message_list

278	def supports_stop_parameter(model_id: str) -> bool:
279	    """
280	    Check if the model supports the `stop` parameter.
281	
282	    Not supported with reasoning models openai/o3 and openai/o4-mini (and their versioned variants).

284	    Args:

301	def instance_to_source(instance, base_cls=None):
302	    """Convert an instance to its class source code representation."""
303	    cls = instance.__class__
304	    class_name = cls.__name__
305	
306	    # Start building class lines
307	    class_lines = []
308	    if base_cls:
309	        class_lines.append(f"class {class_name}({base_cls.__name__}):")
310	    else:
311	        class_lines.append(f"class {class_name}:")
312	
313	    # Add docstring if it exists and differs from base
314	    if cls.__doc__ and (not base_cls or cls.__doc__ != base_cls.__doc__):
315	        class_lines.append(f'    """{cls.__doc__}"""')
316	
317	    # Add class-level attributes
318	    class_attrs = {
319	        name: value
320	        for name, value in cls.__dict__.items()
321	        if not name.startswith("__")
322	        and not callable(value)
323	        and not (base_cls and hasattr(base_cls, name) and getattr(base_cls, name) == value)
324	    }
325	
326	    for name, value in class_attrs.items():
327	        if isinstance(value, str):
328	            # multiline value
329	            if "\n" in value:
330	                escaped_value = value.replace('"""', r"\"\"\"")  # Escape triple quotes
331	                class_lines.append(f'    {name} = """{escaped_value}"""')
332	            else:
333	                class_lines.append(f"    {name} = {json.dumps(value)}")
334	        else:
335	            class_lines.append(f"    {name} = {repr(value)}")
336	
337	    if class_attrs:
338	        class_lines.append("")
339	
340	    # Add methods
341	    methods = {
342	        name: func.__wrapped__ if hasattr(func, "__wrapped__") else func
343	        for name, func in cls.__dict__.items()
344	        if callable(func)
345	        and (
346	            not base_cls
347	            or not hasattr(base_cls, name)
348	            or (
349	                isinstance(func, (staticmethod, classmethod))
350	                or (getattr(base_cls, name).__code__.co_code != func.__code__.co_code)
351	            )
352	        )
353	    }
354	
355	    for name, method in methods.items():
356	        method_source = get_source(method)
357	        # Clean up the indentation
358	        method_lines = method_source.split("\n")
359	        first_line = method_lines[0]
360	        indent = len(first_line) - len(first_line.lstrip())
361	        method_lines = [line[indent:] for line in method_lines]
362	        method_source = "\n".join(["    " + line if line.strip() else line for line in method_lines])
363	        class_lines.append(method_source)
364	        class_lines.append("")
365	
366	    # Find required imports using ImportFinder
367	    import_finder = ImportFinder()
368	    import_finder.visit(ast.parse("\n".join(class_lines)))
369	    required_imports = import_finder.packages
370	
371	    # Build final code with imports
372	    final_lines = []
373	
374	    # Add base class import if needed
375	    if base_cls:
376	        final_lines.append(f"from {base_cls.__module__} import {base_cls.__name__}")
377	
378	    # Add discovered imports
379	    for package in required_imports:
380	        final_lines.append(f"import {package}")
381	
382	    if final_lines:  # Add empty line after imports
383	        final_lines.append("")
384	
385	    # Add the class code
386	    final_lines.extend(class_lines)
387	
388	    return "\n".join(final_lines)

391	def get_source(obj) -> str:
392	    """Get the source code of a class or callable object (e.g.: function, method).
393	    First attempts to get the source code using `inspect.getsource`.
394	    In a dynamic environment (e.g.: Jupyter, IPython), if this fails,
395	    falls back to retrieving the source code from the current interactive shell session.
396	
397	    Args:
398	        obj: A class or callable object (e.g.: function, method)
399	
400	    Returns:
401	        str: The source code of the object, dedented and stripped
402	
403	    Raises:
404	        TypeError: If object is not a class or callable
405	        OSError: If source code cannot be retrieved from any source
406	        ValueError: If source cannot be found in IPython history
407	
408	    Note:
409	        TODO: handle Python standard REPL
410	    """
411	    if not (isinstance(obj, type) or callable(obj)):
412	        raise TypeError(f"Expected class or callable, got {type(obj)}")
413	
414	    inspect_error = None
415	    try:
416	        # Handle dynamically created classes
417	        source = getattr(obj, "__source__", None) or inspect.getsource(obj)
418	        return dedent(source).strip()
419	    except OSError as e:
420	        # let's keep track of the exception to raise it if all further methods fail
421	        inspect_error = e
422	    try:
423	        import IPython
424	
425	        shell = IPython.get_ipython()
426	        if not shell:
427	            raise ImportError("No active IPython shell found")
428	        all_cells = "\n".join(shell.user_ns.get("In", [])).strip()
429	        if not all_cells:
430	            raise ValueError("No code cells found in IPython session")
431	
432	        tree = ast.parse(all_cells)
433	        for node in ast.walk(tree):
434	            if isinstance(node, (ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef)) and node.name == obj.__name__:
435	                return dedent("\n".join(all_cells.split("\n")[node.lineno - 1 : node.end_lineno])).strip()
436	        raise ValueError(f"Could not find source code for {obj.__name__} in IPython history")
437	    except ImportError:
438	        # IPython is not available, let's just raise the original inspect error
439	        raise inspect_error
440	    except ValueError as e:
441	        # IPython is available but we couldn't find the source code, let's raise the error
442	        raise e from inspect_error

391	def get_source(obj) -> str:
392	    """Get the source code of a class or callable object (e.g.: function, method).
393	    First attempts to get the source code using `inspect.getsource`.
394	    In a dynamic environment (e.g.: Jupyter, IPython), if this fails,
395	    falls back to retrieving the source code from the current interactive shell session.

397	    Args:
398	        obj: A class or callable object (e.g.: function, method)
399

401	        str: The source code of the object, dedented and stripped
402

405	        OSError: If source code cannot be retrieved from any source
406	        ValueError: If source cannot be found in IPython history
407	
408	    Note:

410	    """
411	    if not (isinstance(obj, type) or callable(obj)):
412	        raise TypeError(f"Expected class or callable, got {type(obj)}")

415	    try:
416	        # Handle dynamically created classes

419	    except OSError as e:

437	    except ImportError:

import argparse
from io import BytesIO
from time import sleep

import helium
import PIL.Image
from dotenv import load_dotenv
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.common.keys import Keys

from smolagents import CodeAgent, WebSearchTool, tool
from smolagents.agents import ActionStep
from smolagents.cli import load_model


github_request = """
I'm trying to find how hard I have to work to get a repo in github.com/trending.
Can you navigate to the profile for the top author of the top trending repo, and give me their total number of commits over the last year?
"""  # The agent is able to achieve this request only when powered by GPT-4o or Claude-3.5-sonnet.

search_request = """
Please navigate to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chicago and give me a sentence containing the word "1992" that mentions a construction accident.
"""


def parse_arguments():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run a web browser automation script with a specified model.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "prompt",
        type=str,
        nargs="?",  # Makes it optional
        default=search_request,
        help="The prompt to run with the agent",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--model-type",
        type=str,
        default="LiteLLMModel",
        help="The model type to use (e.g., OpenAIServerModel, LiteLLMModel, TransformersModel, InferenceClientModel)",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--model-id",
        type=str,
        default="gpt-4o",
        help="The model ID to use for the specified model type",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--provider",
        type=str,
        help="The inference provider to use for the model",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--api-base",
        type=str,
        help="The API base to use for the model",
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--api-key",
        type=str,
        help="The API key to use for the model",
    )
    return parser.parse_args()


def save_screenshot(memory_step: ActionStep, agent: CodeAgent) -> None:
    sleep(1.0)  # Let JavaScript animations happen before taking the screenshot
    driver = helium.get_driver()
    current_step = memory_step.step_number
    if driver is not None:
        for previous_memory_step in agent.memory.steps:  # Remove previous screenshots from logs for lean processing
            if isinstance(previous_memory_step, ActionStep) and previous_memory_step.step_number <= current_step - 2:
                previous_memory_step.observations_images = None
        png_bytes = driver.get_screenshot_as_png()
        image = PIL.Image.open(BytesIO(png_bytes))
        print(f"Captured a browser screenshot: {image.size} pixels")
        memory_step.observations_images = [image.copy()]  # Create a copy to ensure it persists, important!

    # Update observations with current URL
    url_info = f"Current url: {driver.current_url}"
    memory_step.observations = (
        url_info if memory_step.observations is None else memory_step.observations + "\n" + url_info
    )
    return


@tool
def search_item_ctrl_f(text: str, nth_result: int = 1) -> str:
    """
    Searches for text on the current page via Ctrl + F and jumps to the nth occurrence.
    Args:
        text: The text to search for
        nth_result: Which occurrence to jump to (default: 1)
    """
    elements = driver.find_elements(By.XPATH, f"//*[contains(text(), '{text}')]")
    if nth_result > len(elements):
        raise Exception(f"Match n°{nth_result} not found (only {len(elements)} matches found)")
    result = f"Found {len(elements)} matches for '{text}'."
    elem = elements[nth_result - 1]
    driver.execute_script("arguments[0].scrollIntoView(true);", elem)
    result += f"Focused on element {nth_result} of {len(elements)}"
    return result


@tool
def go_back() -> None:
    """Goes back to previous page."""
    driver.back()


@tool
def close_popups() -> str:
    """
    Closes any visible modal or pop-up on the page. Use this to dismiss pop-up windows! This does not work on cookie consent banners.
    """
    webdriver.ActionChains(driver).send_keys(Keys.ESCAPE).perform()


def initialize_driver():
    """Initialize the Selenium WebDriver."""
    chrome_options = webdriver.ChromeOptions()
    chrome_options.add_argument("--force-device-scale-factor=1")
    chrome_options.add_argument("--window-size=1000,1350")
    chrome_options.add_argument("--disable-pdf-viewer")
    chrome_options.add_argument("--window-position=0,0")
    return helium.start_chrome(headless=False, options=chrome_options)


def initialize_agent(model):
    """Initialize the CodeAgent with the specified model."""
    return CodeAgent(
        tools=[WebSearchTool(), go_back, close_popups, search_item_ctrl_f],
        model=model,
        additional_authorized_imports=["helium"],
        step_callbacks=[save_screenshot],
        max_steps=20,
        verbosity_level=2,
    )


helium_instructions = """
Use your web_search tool when you want to get Google search results.
Then you can use helium to access websites. Don't use helium for Google search, only for navigating websites!
Don't bother about the helium driver, it's already managed.
We've already ran "from helium import *"
Then you can go to pages!
Code:
```py
go_to('github.com/trending')
```<end_code>

You can directly click clickable elements by inputting the text that appears on them.
Code:
```py
click("Top products")
```<end_code>

If it's a link:
Code:
```py
click(Link("Top products"))
```<end_code>

If you try to interact with an element and it's not found, you'll get a LookupError.
In general stop your action after each button click to see what happens on your screenshot.
Never try to login in a page.

To scroll up or down, use scroll_down or scroll_up with as an argument the number of pixels to scroll from.
Code:
```py
scroll_down(num_pixels=1200) # This will scroll one viewport down
```<end_code>

When you have pop-ups with a cross icon to close, don't try to click the close icon by finding its element or targeting an 'X' element (this most often fails).
Just use your built-in tool `close_popups` to close them:
Code:
```py
close_popups()
```<end_code>

You can use .exists() to check for the existence of an element. For example:
Code:
```py
if Text('Accept cookies?').exists():
    click('I accept')
```<end_code>

Proceed in several steps rather than trying to solve the task in one shot.
And at the end, only when you have your answer, return your final answer.
Code:
```py
final_answer("YOUR_ANSWER_HERE")
```<end_code>

If pages seem stuck on loading, you might have to wait, for instance `import time` and run `time.sleep(5.0)`. But don't overuse this!
To list elements on page, DO NOT try code-based element searches like 'contributors = find_all(S("ol > li"))': just look at the latest screenshot you have and read it visually, or use your tool search_item_ctrl_f.
Of course, you can act on buttons like a user would do when navigating.
After each code blob you write, you will be automatically provided with an updated screenshot of the browser and the current browser url.
But beware that the screenshot will only be taken at the end of the whole action, it won't see intermediate states.
Don't kill the browser.
When you have modals or cookie banners on screen, you should get rid of them before you can click anything else.
"""


def run_webagent(
    prompt: str,
    model_type: str,
    model_id: str,
    provider: str | None = None,
    api_base: str | None = None,
    api_key: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    # Load environment variables
    load_dotenv()

    # Initialize the model based on the provided arguments
    model = load_model(model_type, model_id, provider=provider, api_base=api_base, api_key=api_key)

    global driver
    driver = initialize_driver()
    agent = initialize_agent(model)

    # Run the agent with the provided prompt
    agent.python_executor("from helium import *")
    agent.run(prompt + helium_instructions)


def main() -> None:
    # Parse command line arguments
    args = parse_arguments()
    run_webagent(args.prompt, args.model_type, args.model_id, args.provider, args.api_base, args.api_key)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

  Observation: "The oldest person in the document is John Doe, a 55 year old lumberjack living in Newfoundland."

  ---
  Task:

  print(f"The translated question is {translated_question}.")
  answer = image_qa(image=image, question=translated_question)
  final_answer(f"The answer is {answer}")
  ```<end_code>

  ---
  Task:
  In a 1979 interview, Stanislaus Ulam discusses with Martin Sherwin about other great physicists of his time, including Oppenheimer.
  What does he say was the consequence of Einstein learning too much math on his creativity, in one word?

  Manhattan Project Locations:
  Los Alamos, NM

  ```<end_code>

  You are an expert assistant who can solve any task using tool calls. You will be given a task to solve as best you can.
  To do so, you have been given access to some tools.

  The tool call you write is an action: after the tool is executed, you will get the result of the tool call as an "observation".
  This Action/Observation can repeat N times, you should take several steps when needed.

  You can use the result of the previous action as input for the next action.
  The observation will always be a string: it can represent a file, like "image_1.jpg".
  Then you can use it as input for the next action. You can do it for instance as follows:

  Observation: "image_1.jpg"

  Action:
  {
    "name": "image_transformer",
    "arguments": {"image": "image_1.jpg"}
  }

  To provide the final answer to the task, use an action blob with "name": "final_answer" tool. It is the only way to complete the task, else you will be stuck on a loop. So your final output should look like this:
  Action:
  {
    "name": "final_answer",
    "arguments": {"answer": "insert your final answer here"}
  }


  Here are a few examples using notional tools:
  ---
  Task: "Generate an image of the oldest person in this document."

  Action:
  {
    "name": "document_qa",
    "arguments": {"document": "document.pdf", "question": "Who is the oldest person mentioned?"}
  }
  Observation: "The oldest person in the document is John Doe, a 55 year old lumberjack living in Newfoundland."

  Action:
  {
    "name": "image_generator",
    "arguments": {"prompt": "A portrait of John Doe, a 55-year-old man living in Canada."}
  }
  Observation: "image.png"

  Action:
  {
    "name": "final_answer",
    "arguments": "image.png"
  }

  ---
  Task: "What is the result of the following operation: 5 + 3 + 1294.678?"

  Action:
  {
      "name": "python_interpreter",
      "arguments": {"code": "5 + 3 + 1294.678"}
  }
  Observation: 1302.678

  Action:
  {
    "name": "final_answer",
    "arguments": "1302.678"
  }

  ---
  Task: "Which city has the highest population , Guangzhou or Shanghai?"

  Action:
  {
      "name": "web_search",
      "arguments": "Population Guangzhou"
  }
  Observation: ['Guangzhou has a population of 15 million inhabitants as of 2021.']


  Action:
  {
      "name": "web_search",
      "arguments": "Population Shanghai"
  }
  Observation: '26 million (2019)'

  Action:
  {
    "name": "final_answer",
    "arguments": "Shanghai"

  {%- for tool in tools.values() %}
